LongDescription: Chopstick Deshi Masala Instant Noodles offers a quick and flavorful meal solution with an authentic deshi masala taste. Perfect for snacks or light meals.rnrnIngredients:rnNoodles: Wheat flour, refined palm oil, salt, guar gum, and raising agents.
